vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: sonnet-model-router
Version: 2.2.0

The 'sonnet-model-router' skill is a utility designed to optimize model selection in OpenClaw based on performance benchmarks and cost. It functions by reading provider metadata via 'gateway config.get', maintaining a local 'model-registry.json' file, and performing web searches for model specifications. The logic in SKILL.md and README.md emphasizes transparency, explicitly instructing the agent to avoid sensitive credentials and to obtain user consent before modifying system configurations via 'gateway config.patch'.
